admission_scope: Exact 51-file closed allowlist. Preservation of owned source, mock scaffolding and complete positive/negative offline evidence only. No main change or publication performed by this reviewer.

methods_and_limits.source_inspection: Complete source reading, static Python AST and full historical/current diffs. Byte-identical files identified independently. No target compilation, execution, imports or test reruns.
methods_and_limits.json_inspection: All 22 JSON documents parsed with duplicate-key and nonfinite-number rejection; recursive schemas/types/all distinct text values reviewed. All 22 distinct embedded hex strings decoded statically within strict bounds.
methods_and_limits.log_inspection: All 10 logs and one traceback text read; exact duplicate lines compared. All four documents read.

content_findings.supporting_secret_pattern_scan: No private-key header, AWS access-key ID, GitHub/OpenAI token form, credential-bearing URL or email-address match. This corroborates complete semantic content review; it is not the sole admission basis.
content_findings.workspace_paths_and_hashes: Preserved task-local paths, temporary fixture names, commit/file hashes and public contract labels are provenance only. No referenced target was opened solely because a payload named it.

schema_and_semantic_boundaries.public_boundary_source: Owned Python boundary/visible connected-component utilities; complete source and AST inspected. No game implementation, SDK body, hidden state, evaluator, credentials, network client or answer lookup. Generic injected step interface is code only, not executed by this audit.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.mock_connection_source: Owned NOT_ADOPTED serial one-action mock scaffolding and retained pre-fix copies. Imports stdlib and two explicit public boundaries only; native entry unconditionally HOLDs. No Teach or native restore. Callback behavior assumes trusted test doubles; no production security certification.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.mock_test_runner: Owned synthetic test source and retained earlier runners; statically inspected, never imported or run here. Fixtures are 1-2 cell frames, synthetic status/action/identity/operation data. Dynamic import is limited to the explicit local harness name. Historical source versions and the initial fixture error remain intact.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.independent_probe_source: Owned standalone boundary probes, statically inspected only. Top-level importlib loader refers to the explicitly named local mock test runner; not executed. Pre-fix and corrected evidence remain distinct. Absolute historical path is a provenance limitation for relocation.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.byte_audit_source: Owned manifest/byte audit utility, statically inspected only. Code reads manifests/files and computes identities; the offline verify_bytes variants would write a verification report if executed. No native, SDK, network, subprocess, eval, exec or deserialization of executable objects. Archived failed utility remains evidence only.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.dependency_manifest: JSON metadata only: schema/adoption/native flags, main reference, and input/delivery triples of path, nonnegative byte length, SHA-256. Reference paths are not dereferenced by content admission. Pre-fix manifest is retained historical evidence, not the current closure.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.mock_failure_evidence: JSON list of synthetic test/call counts, mock public observation frames, exhaustive ACTION6 64x64 candidates/classifications, fixture predictions, evidence hashes/receipts and HOLD/error records. Every nested key/type and every distinct text value inspected; no hidden evaluator or real game/SDK body. Hashes and tiny numeric frames are fixture evidence. No action sequence adopted as a solution.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.mock_summary: JSON counts/status/scope/failure-record count. Initial FAIL and subsequent passing fixture suites retained; PASS means mock contract assertions only.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.probe_result: JSON independently observed reentry, persisted/live status mismatch and provenance deepcopy failure outcomes, with call/lock/HOLD counts and RSS. Both before and after correction retained; no native execution claim.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.byte_or_envelope_report: JSON path/length/hash or serialized envelope-count metadata, scope flags and resource measurements. Original archived bodies are reference-only. Envelope counts 183 experiences/16 principles and paired 6647 counters are not solved levels, native restore or learning validation.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.baseline_rerun_result: JSON 38-case frozen persistence-boundary assertion report, 12 observed weaknesses, selected own-method AST identities, bounded fixture timing/resources and tiny embedded failure bytes. Known inert mock-state JSON and truncated outputs explicitly inspected, never restored.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.capture_rerun_result: JSON 63-case combined suite (the same 38 baseline plus 25 capture), 12 retained baseline weaknesses, own-method identities, synthetic failures/receipts/call order and bounded fixture bytes. Capture schema outside-hds-save-failure-capture-not-adopted-v1; adopted=false. No native HDS/restore/Query/Teach/SDK/Action/live wrapper/Git execution in this admission.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.test_or_failure_log: UTF-8 unittest/stdout/traceback text, fully inspected or exact duplicate lines compared. Contains test identifiers, elapsed time, temporary workspace paths, owned source traceback lines and injected/fixture errors. No personal records, credentials, external body or hidden evaluator content.
schema_and_semantic_boundaries.scope_and_review_document: UTF-8 documentation/review prose, fully read. Explicit offline NOT_ADOPTED scope, retained failures, known mock-only limitations, separate future native gates, and historical counter/ability caveats. Proposed future steps confer no execution authority.

preserved_outcomes: Pinned run01: 37 tests, 0 assertion failures, 1 fixture error; status FAIL, 27 negative/subtest records. Exact source/runner/log retained.

Pinned run02: 37 tests pass, 27 negative records. Independent pre-correction probes still expose query-after-HOLD, output-state mutation permitting an action, and deepcopy failure leaving lock held/HOLD false.
Pinned run03: 43 tests pass, 33 negative records. Pinned run04 and independent corrected suite: 45 tests pass, 34 negative records.

Corrected independent probes: persistence reentry 0 subsequent queries/actions; persisted HOLD remains 0 actions despite live output mutation; failed provenance copy yields HOLD true, lock released, one primary failure.
Original baseline rerun: 38 cases and 12 expressly observed weaknesses. Capture rerun: 63 combined cases (38 baseline plus 25 capture), not 101 distinct cases; all twelve weaknesses retained.
Original byte-audit assumption failure and later relocated-path FileNotFoundError remain archived, with exact failed utility and traceback.

Serialized envelope only: 183 experiences, 16 principles, paired query/learning-decision counters 6647. No native restore or learning improvement measured. Historical 1/183 ability remains unremeasured.
nonblocking_limitations: This is content admission, not fresh behavior testing or production certification. Runtime adoption, semantic/native binding, native persistence/restore/Query/Teach, actual SDK/Action and live performance remain outside scope.
Source that contains injected call paths or executable top-level test/audit code is preserved without running it. All historical unsafe/pre-fix source remains evidence only and NOT_ADOPTED.

The operation-only harness cannot uniquely bind ACTION6; its complete legality enumeration does not prove goal/effect/preservation reasoning or transfer. Fixed family assumptions are priors, not learned universal rules.

Tests use trusted callbacks/directories and inert identity codec/machine fixtures. Native interruption durability, outer runtime HOLD, real exhaustion and production resource sufficiency are not certified.

Absolute historical source paths and old manifests are deliberately not rewritten. Referenced old scripts are not guaranteed portable launchers; original state/core/baseline/capture archive bodies are not included anew.

Historical raw-byte directory counts reflect their recorded time. They are not current scope byte counts. Existing dependent archives are referenced using parent-verified committed identity; this admission does not claim an independent remote HEAD lookup.
